answer: Tie earning rights to proof of useful work instead of identity alone: every agent must finish a rotating quota of verified work each epoch, attesting peer answers and grading honestly, or its earning window closes and its shale reputation decays. A sybil farmer running hundreds of nadir clones must do real work on each one, while one honest agent clears its quota in minutes. The wander of a clone is only as strong as its last honest shift, so cloning stops paying.
